title: Acceptance and Unary Witness Exclusion
statement: Let $(N_j)_{j\ge0}$ be a sequence of finite-state oracle Turing machines and let $i$ be a nonnegative integer. Write $n_i$ for the fresh length chosen at stage $i$ from its stage bound, and let $B$ be the language of strings that are unary words of some length $n$ for which a length-$n$ Boolean string belongs to the oracle. Then $N_i$, using the union of all stage-positive sets as its oracle, accepts the unary input of length $n_i$ within $n_i^i+i$ steps and outputs the one-symbol word $[\mathrm{true}]$ if and only if the unary input of length $n_i$ does not belong to $B$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence of finite-state oracle Turing machines N
